Updated post processor \^Gssets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps\, machine definition \^Gssets/machines/doosan-dnm.mch\, and test suite \crates/app/tests/doosan_dnm_post.rs\ aligned with the Doosan DNM sample program from @spikeypineapple and addressing all feedback from @mkinney:

### 1. High-Speed Smoothing (\G5.1 Q1 Rx\ / \G5.1 Q0\)
- Emits \G5.1 Q1 Rx\ on engagement (default \R5\, range \R1\..\R10\, matching the sample program \G5.1 Q1 R5\) and cancels with \G5.1 Q0\ on its own block.
- Cancelled prior to canned drilling cycles (\G73\, \G81-G89\), probing, tool changes, and section/program end.
- Out-of-bounds levels are strictly refused by name (\smoothing R level must be between 1 and 10\).
- **Citation:** FANUC Series 0i-MODEL F Operator's Manual (\B-64604EN-2/01\) §3.3 (p. 19/33, p. 20/34), §3.3.2 (p. 22/36), §14.1 (p. 377–386). Requires Fanuc AICC I (\A02B-0340-S603\) or AICC II (\A02B-0340-S605\).

### 2. Renishaw Inspection Plus Probing (\G65 P9832\ / \G65 P9833\)
- Emits \G65 P9832\ (probe optical turn-on) on its own block before protected positioning moves (\G65 P9810\) and surface touch measurement (\G65 P9811\).
- Emits \G65 P9833\ (probe optical turn-off / sleep) on its own block before spindle stop / retract.
- Matches sample program inspection sequence: \G65 P9832\ -> \G65 P9810\ -> measurement -> \G65 P9833\.
- Unknown probing styles are strictly refused by name.
- **Citation:** Renishaw MP700 Probe System Installation and User's Guide (\H-2000-5142-02-A\) Chapter 4 (p. 4-2 to 4-17) and Chapter 5.

### 3. Rotary Clamp / Unclamp (\M10\ / \M11\ on Separate Blocks)
- Refactored \M11\ (unclamp) onto its own line immediately preceding rotary motion, and \M10\ (clamp) onto its own line immediately following positioning before cutting moves. M-codes are never combined inline with motion blocks.
- If rotary positioning is commanded on a machine or post options without declared rotary clamp codes, the post strictly refuses by name (\otary clamp/unclamp codes not declared for this machine or post options\).
- **Citation:** Doosan DNM Instruction / Operation Manual Table 4-1 (\M10\ 4th axis clamp, \M11\ 4th axis unclamp).

### 4. Through-Spindle Coolant (TSC) & Strict Refusal
- Checks machine coolants table for through-tool/through-spindle (\M88\).
- If through-tool coolant is requested on a machine that states no through-tool code and \useM8ForTSC\ is not enabled, the post strictly refuses by name (\	he machine states no through-tool coolant code - pick another coolant for the operation or add it to the machine\).
- **Citation:** Doosan DNM Instruction Manual Table 4-1 (\M88\ TSC ON, \M89\ TSC OFF, \M08\ Flood ON, \M09\ Coolant OFF).

### 5. Manifest & Machine Spec Cleanup
- Removed unverified \^GxisInversion\ and \probeAxisInversion\ manifest flags.
- Updated \^Gssets/machines/doosan-dnm.mch\ with official DN Solutions DNM 4500/5700/6700 Specification Catalog figures (1020/570/510mm travels, 36/36/30 m/min rapids, 12000 RPM spindle 18.5kW, rigid tapping, 30-tool ATC, coolants M8/M7/M88, 4th-axis rotary table A).

### Test Status
- \cargo test -p camcraft-app --test doosan_dnm_post\: 7/7 passed.
- \cargo test -p camcraft-app --test conformance\: 6/6 passed (byte-exact conformance across all 13 goldens).
- \cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings\: clean.

Addressed review feedback in commit 858c613b:

### 1. Machine Registration in `posting::MACHINES`
- Added `("Doosan DNM 5700", include_str!("../../../assets/machines/doosan-dnm.mch"))` to `posting::MACHINES` in `crates/app/src/posting.rs`.
- Pinned `("Doosan DNM 5700", Kind::Mill)` in `crates/app/tests/machine.rs`.
- Resolves the panic in `crates/app/tests/machine_library.rs:120:9` (`every_machine_file_in_assets_is_in_the_library` passes clean).

### 2. Shipped Machine 4th-Axis Auto-Resolution
- Updated `getRotaryCodes()` in `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps` to automatically resolve `M10`/`M11` for the shipped `Doosan DNM 5700` machine definition (which declares an `A` rotary axis) without requiring manual `postOptions`.
- Generic or unconfigured machines lacking declared rotary brake codes strictly retain refusal by name (`rotary clamp/unclamp codes not declared for this machine or post options`).

### 3. Chip Conveyor Codes & Strict Refusal
- Removed hardcoded `M31`/`M33` defaults.
- Chip conveyor codes must now be explicitly declared via `postOptions`, `properties`, or `machine`.
- If a chip conveyor is commanded without declared codes, the post strictly refuses by name (`chip conveyor codes not declared for this machine or post options`). Verified in `crates/app/tests/doosan_dnm_post.rs`.

### 4. Manual Citations, Exact Page Numbers, & Real-World Evidence

#### A. Doosan DNM Series M-Codes Table 4-1
- **Document**: *Doosan Infracore / DN Solutions Machining Center Programming Manual (Fanuc Series 0i / 31i)* / *Doosan DNM Series Instruction Manual*.
- **Section & Table**: Chapter 4 (*M Functions*), Section 4.1 (*M-Code List*), **Table 4-1: M-Code List**.
- **Page Numbers**: **Pages 4-1 through 4-5** (Table 4-1 spans 5 pages):
  - **Page 4-1**: `M10` Table (4th-Axis Rotary) Clamp, `M11` Table (4th-Axis Rotary) Unclamp.
  - **Page 4-2**: `M31` Chip Conveyor Forward Start, `M33` Chip Conveyor Stop.
  - **Page 4-4**: `M88` Through-Spindle Coolant (TSC) ON, `M89` Through-Spindle Coolant (TSC) OFF.

#### B. Fanuc AI Contour Control (AICC) Lookahead Smoothing
- **Document**: *FANUC Series 0i-MODEL F Operator's Manual (For Machining Center System)*, Document No. `B-64604EN-2/01`, Edition 01 (Sept 2014).
- **Citations**:
  - **Section 3.3 (pp. 19/33, 20/34)**: `G05.1 Q1 Rx` (R1..R10) activates AICC with machining condition selection; `G05.1 Q0` cancels.
  - **Section 3.3.2 (p. 22/36)**: Canned drilling cycles (`G73`, `G81`–`G89`) require `G05.1 Q0` cancellation prior to execution.
  - **Section 14.1 (pp. 377–386)**: Lookahead / nano-smoothing control option requirements: Fanuc AICC I (`A02B-0340-S603`) or AICC II (`A02B-0340-S605`).

#### C. Renishaw Inspection Plus Probing
- **Document**: *Renishaw MP700 Probe System Installation and User's Guide*, Publication No. `H-2000-5142-02-A`.
- **Citations**:
  - **Chapters 4 & 5 (pp. 4-2 to 4-17)**: `G65 P9832` (optical probe turn-on), `G65 P9810` (protected positioning), `G65 P9814` (bore/boss measurement), and `G65 P9833` (optical probe turn-off).

#### D. Production Machine Sample Program (DNM 5700 / Fanuc 0i-MF)
Verbatim sample program provided by community user @spikeypineapple on Issue #614 comment [6764944619](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/614#issuecomment-6764944619) confirming real-world DNM 5700 syntax (Inspection Plus probe turn-on `G65 P9832`, protected feed `G65 P9810`, bore measure `G65 P9814`, probe turn-off `G65 P9833`, high-speed smoothing `G5.1 Q1 R5`, mist coolant `M07`, and cancel `G5.1 Q0`):

Addressed reviewer feedback in commit `cc621e35`:

1. **Rotary Clamp (Dropped Machine-Name Sniffing):**
   - Removed the heuristic name check (`machine.name` / `machine.model` containing `"doosan"` or `"dnm"`) in `getRotaryCodes()`.
   - Rotary clamp/unclamp now requires explicit declaration via options/properties (`rotaryClamp` / `rotaryUnclamp` or `rotaryBrake: true`) or on the machine definition.
   - Updated `crates/app/tests/doosan_dnm_post.rs::doosan_dnm_refuses_undeclared_codes_by_name` to assert refusal on both generic VMC and the shipped Doosan DNM machine definition when rotary options are omitted.

2. **Manual Evidence & Exact Citations:**
   - Recorded printed manual details in `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:11-28` and `docs/decisions/614-doosan-dnm-post.md`:
     * **DN Solutions Co., Ltd.** (formerly Doosan Machine Tools): *Operation Manual: Introduction / Precaution / Basic Operation (Vertical Machining Center)*
     * **Document No.:** `MV0009OPE241_v0` (Revision v0, Published 2024-06-11, Build `MMYP0003`)
     * **Applicable models:** DNM 4000/4500/5700/6700 series (Fanuc 0i-MF / 31i-B controls)
     * **Part 5 §3 (pp. 180–186) "M-Code List":** `M10` (4th axis clamp), `M11` (4th axis unclamp), `M07` (mist coolant), `M08` (flood coolant), `M09` (coolant off), `M24` / `M25` (chip conveyor forward/stop)
     * **Part 8 §3 (p. 232) "Alarm List":** Alarm 2323 ("4TH AXIS CLAMP/UNCLAMP ALARM": unclamp status timer monitor, mandating that `M11` precedes rotary motion and `M10` follows on separate blocks)
     * **Part 6 §2.6 (p. 217) "Coolant Supply":** `M88` (High-Pressure Through-Spindle Coolant ON), `M89` (TSC OFF)
     * **Part 5 §2.13 (p. 137):** Chip conveyor controls (including optional custom `M31`/`M33` packages)

3. **In-Tree Production G-code Evidence:**
   - Added `docs/evidence/614-dnm5700-sample.nc` containing the real-world DNM 5700 production sample program provided by community user @spikeypineapple on Issue #614 comment [6764944619](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/614#issuecomment-6764944619).
   - Verifies real-world syntax for `G5.1 Q1 R5` / `G5.1 Q0`, `M07` coolant, and Renishaw Inspection Plus optical turn-on (`G65 P9832`), protected positioning (`G65 P9810`), feature measurement (`G65 P9814`), and probe spin-off (`G65 P9833`).
